notes.text: Shushan =" lily" the winter residence of the Persian kings; located on the river Ulai or Choaspes - note the lily was the symbol of purity - Esther's story takes place with the purity.

notes.text: In ancient times kings often relied on "wise men, which knew the times." These "wise men" were court magicians or astrologers who tried to foretell the future by reading stars and planets. Isaiah warned that such men have "no light in them" (Isaiah 8:19-20).
